args.response: Refined Requirement 25. Amended criterion 6 to add a measurable coverage threshold and defined failure behavior, and added two new criteria: one quantifying minimum line coverage, and one specifying boundary-value verification for domain-valid inputs adjacent to Domain_Error boundaries. Criteria 1-5 were already well-bounded (10 significant digits, enumerated functions) and preserved unchanged. Stayed within the 3-new-criteria budget and preserved Glossary terms and numbering.
